title: The Scottish Sailors and the English Captain
text: Jose was absolutely amazing! Very supportive and patient with my two brothers, would defo recommend! Was talkative and funny, very good laugh 🫶🏼
author: marinaaskew

title: Kayaking in Seville
text: Enjoyable experience, a different way to see Seville that was a lot of fun. Also provided a valid excuse for an ice cream, which is never a bad thing.
author: 66edgar6

title: Fun on the water
text: The history told to us on the way. The guide was very friendly. The day was beautiful. The length was perfect.
author: Stephanie_W

title: Recommended
text: Exactly what I was looking for: fun and active way to experience the city. Really enjoyed the tour and to see the city from the river. Also saw a lot of turtles in the water 🐢
author: Gina_G

title: Super
text: Wonderful kayak along the river we were so surprised to see turtles chilling in the sun. Also the river is such a nice say to see this stunning city...the river is a hive of activity.
author: Jennifer_M

title: Nice time
text: Definitely something different. Really enjoyed kayaking. Our guide was nice and knew how to kayak but was hoping for some information on sites we passed.  She was just there if we needed instruction. If you know how to kayak a guide is not necessary. Nothing against our guide
author: karenmA3882MR

title: Great way to see Seville! Take trunks!
text: It was a great experience! I went with my four boys (16, 14, 12 and 9) and it was brilliant. I was a little apprehensive as to how they would be but the guide was great. She was very patient and took us a fair distance down the river. The club was easy to find and it was just us so a small group which made the experience better as we weren’t worried about others. Would recommend :-)
author: Helena_F

title: Happy morning on the Guadalquivir
text: It was a lovely and quiet morning on the river, seeing the city sights from a different point of view.
author: Caroline_M

title: A very good experience!
text: A very nice way to discover Seville! We completed the route faster than expected which did not prevent our guide from extending the discovery. We had some explanations as to the different locations. We recommend!
author: zum3l43v3r

title: If you go to Seville you have to try it!!
text: Thank you very much Miguel for giving us such a pleasant time in Guadalquivir. The activity we loved, we will repeat again!!
author: Elizabeth P
